INSERT INTO health_logs (disk_used_pct, backup_age_hours, cpu_load, memory_used_pct, pg_connections, n8n_status, uptime_seconds, checked_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.disk_used_pct }},
  {{ $json.backup_age_hours }},
  {{ $json.cpu_load }},
  {{ $json.memory_used_pct }},
  {{ $json.pg_connections }},
  '{{ $json.n8n_status }}',
  {{ $json.uptime_seconds }},
  NOW()
);

INSERT INTO alerts (alert_type, severity, message, metadata, created_at)
VALUES (
  'system_warning',
  'high',
  CASE
    WHEN {{ $json.disk_used_pct }} > 85 AND {{ $json.backup_age_hours }} > 26
      THEN 'CRITICAL: Disk usage at ' || {{ $json.disk_used_pct }} || '% AND backup is ' || {{ $json.backup_age_hours }} || ' hours old'
    WHEN {{ $json.disk_used_pct }} > 85
      THEN 'WARNING: Disk usage at ' || {{ $json.disk_used_pct }} || '%'
    ELSE 'WARNING: Backup is ' || {{ $json.backup_age_hours }} || ' hours old (threshold: 26h)'
  END,
  json_build_object(
    'disk_used_pct', {{ $json.disk_used_pct }},
    'backup_age_hours', {{ $json.backup_age_hours }},
    'cpu_load', {{ $json.cpu_load }},
    'memory_used_pct', {{ $json.memory_used_pct }}
  ),
  NOW()
);
